Goodwin keen but realistic over Cameron move - gossip
- Published
Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin admits he would like to formalise Lyall Cameron's loan move from Rangers into a longer term arrangement. (Sun, external)
But Goodwin says United "need to be realistic" regarding their hopes of securing the 24-year-old Cameron beyond this season. (Record - subscription required, external)
Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken seeks unity from his squad following Thursday's 3-1 Conference League defeat by Thun in Switzerland. (Herald - subscription required, external)
Vrancken was pleased with how Stephen Kingsley's teenage replace Matthew Gilliest performed against Thun. (Edinburgh Evening News - subscription required, external)
There will be a new public consultation over Dundee's plans for a new stadium in the Camperdown area. (Courier - subscription required, external)
Aberdeen manager Stephen Robinson says the Dons' committed performance in last weekend's League Cup semi-final loss to Rangers cannot just be for big occasions at Hampden. (Press and Journal - subscription required, external)
